note: Key lifecycle operations that exist, are tested, and have no production caller. Each one is a control the product offers and cannot perform, not a waiver. The guard refuses a new entry and refuses an entry that has since been wired, so this list can only shrink.

unreachable.name: resealConnectorSecrets
unreachable.reason: The job that re-seals connector ciphertext written before the purpose context existed. Until something runs it, every one of those rows keeps opening under any context.
unreachable.owner: a maintenance script beside scripts/reencrypt.mjs, or an operator route

unreachable.name: preloadPlatformKeys
unreachable.reason: The only thing that unseals the platform data key. Without it every key ring resolution under a KMS provider throws, so AGI_KEY_PROVIDER cannot be moved off 'env'.

unreachable.name: provisionOrganizationKey
unreachable.reason: A workspace cannot enrol a key of its own through any surface.

unreachable.name: rotateOrganizationKey
unreachable.reason: A workspace cannot rotate its key through any surface, so the key-compromise response cannot be carried out.

unreachable.name: revokeOrganizationKey
unreachable.reason: A workspace cannot revoke its key, which is the control that makes customer-managed encryption mean anything.

unreachable.name: replaceOrganizationKey
unreachable.reason: A workspace cannot move to a different provider or key uri.

unreachable.name: runOrganizationKeyRewrap
unreachable.reason: Nothing moves ciphertext off a retired key version, so a rotation leaves every earlier row sealed under the old one and retirement can never produce its evidence row.

unreachable.name: retireOrganizationKeyVersion
unreachable.reason: The last step of a rotation, unreachable for the same reason as the rewrap it depends on.
